# Upskld AI

> Upskld AI is an AI education and upskilling platform that teaches practical AI in plain language. It serves small businesses, working professionals and students, with video lessons, MCQ assessments and a free 15-minute session. Upskld is a brand of Impactree Data Technologies.

## Who it is for
- Small businesses: practical AI for sales, marketing, follow-ups and accounts
- Working professionals: AI skills for career growth
- Students: AI learning and career guidance

## Key pages
- [Home](https://upskldai.com/): Overview of Upskld AI, audiences, learning approach and free 15-minute session booking
- [About Us](https://upskldai.com/aboutus): About Upskld AI and Impactree Data Technologies
- [Privacy Policy](https://upskldai.com/privacypolicy): How we collect and use data
- [Terms and Conditions](https://upskldai.com/termsandconditions): Terms for using Upskld AI
